release.headline: Hasbro Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results (Magic passes $600M in a quarter for the first time; 2026 outlook raised; share repurchase target doubled)

vs_bar.consensus_source: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stay-ahead-game-hasbro-q3-121520655.html (Zacks; Nasdaq forecast in the brief also $1.86)

vs_bar.metric: Wizards of the Coast and Digital Gaming revenue

key_line.metric: FY2026 guide and the Q4 it implies
key_line.detail: Guide raised to +7-9% cc (from +5-7%), adj op margin 27-28% (from 25-26%), adj EBITDA $1.575-1.625bn (from $1.45-1.50bn). Q3 includes about $55M of one-off tariff refunds ($48M Consumer Products, $7M Wizards). Own arithmetic on the hunt's H1 figures (about $2.14bn) plus Q3 $1.595bn: the raised range implies Q4 revenue of roughly $1.29-1.39bn against about $1.44bn a year ago, i.e. Q4 down mid-to-high single digits; the 2-point raise (about $95M) is smaller than the Q3 revenue beat over consensus (about $125M). Arithmetic, not a company figure.

guidance.detail: Revenue +7-9% cc (was +5-7%), adj op margin 27-28% (was 25-26%), adj EBITDA $1.575-1.625bn (was $1.45-1.50bn). Raise is below the Q3 beat, so the implied Q4 is lower than a street that had Q3 at +6%.

call.detail: Call began 08:30 ET and is likely still running into the open; no transcript or call coverage found yet. Q4 phasing and the tariff refund are the questions that matter.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions or press coverage of the Q3 2026 release indexed yet at about 09:00 ET; headline is a clear beat and raise.

tape_read.note: Pre-market traded as high as 103.00 (+4.6%) and as low as 97.38 (-1.1%) and last printed 98.59 (+0.1%) at 08:55, during the call. A beat-and-raise headline faded to flat: the market is reading the implied Q4 and the one-off tariff refunds. Far inside the 8.4% implied move. Zero volume on the bars, so the range is prices that existed, not size.

thesis_check.note: Consumer Products missed the Zacks $862M by about 4% (thesis line confirmed) and the guide math still implies a weaker Q4, but Wizards blew out, EPS beat by more than half and the guide was raised rather than held, which is the outcome the short was betting against.

recommendation.limit_basis: Pre-market low (97.3801, -1.1% vs prev close), a level the stock already traded at this morning after the release; about an eighth of the 8.4% implied move below the last pre-market print.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn sterk (omzet en winst ruim boven verwachting, jaarprognose verhoogd), maar de koers is voorbeurs teruggezakt van 103 naar vlak omdat de verhoogde prognose een zwakker vierde kwartaal inhoudt. Er is geen duidelijke richting voor de sessie, dus zet een koopopdracht om de short te sluiten op 97,38 (het voorbeurs-dieptepunt); wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 weer boven 101 komt of er koersdoelverhogingen van analisten binnenkomen, sluit dan direct bij de opening.

searched_and_found_nothing: WebSearch for press/premarket coverage of the 2026-10-20 release: only Q2 2026 (July) items indexed
